name: graveyard-shift
description: A privacy-first wellness companion for Kiro. Your code is alive. But are you?

graveyardShift.reminders.eye.enabled.markdownDescription: Remind me to rest my eyes.

graveyardShift.reminders.eye.minutes.markdownDescription: Minutes of estimated IDE activity between eye-rest reminders.

graveyardShift.reminders.movement.enable.markdownDescription: Remind me to get up and move.

graveyardShift.reminders.movement.minute.markdownDescription: Minutes of estimated IDE activity between movement reminders.

graveyardShift.reminders.hydration.enabl.markdownDescription: Remind me to drink some water.

graveyardShift.reminders.hydration.minut.markdownDescription: Minutes of estimated IDE activity between hydration reminders.

graveyardShift.reminders.snoozeMinutes.markdownDescription: How long **Snooze** waits, in minutes of estimated IDE activity, before showing a reminder again.

graveyardShift.reminders.humanCheckIn.markdownDescription: After a longer break, occasionally ask how I'm doing. Answers are optional and stay in memory unless saving is turned on below.

graveyardShift.reminders.saveCheckInsLoc.markdownDescription: Keep my check-in answers in local extension storage on this machine. They are never sent anywhere.

graveyardShift.companion.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the pixel-art companion. When off, reminders still work without the character.

enumDescriptions: Open The Last Human beside the editor. It never takes focus and can always be dismissed.
Show the long-session message in the sidebar with one standard notification.
graveyardShift.companion.longSessionMode.markdownDescription: How to remind me after a long stretch without a longer break.

graveyardShift.companion.longSessionHour.markdownDescription: Hours of estimated IDE activity without a break of 5 minutes or more before the long-session reminder. This is your own limit, not health guidance.

graveyardShift.companion.tiredAfterMisse.markdownDescription: Skipped or missed break reminders before the companion looks **Tired**. Must be lower than the Infected value.

graveyardShift.companion.infectedAfterMi.markdownDescription: Skipped or missed break reminders before the companion looks **Infected**. Must be between the Tired and Zombie values.

graveyardShift.companion.zombieAfterMiss.markdownDescription: Skipped or missed break reminders before the companion turns **Zombie**. Must be higher than the Infected value.

graveyardShift.experience.sounds.markdownDescription: Play a short, soft cue when a reminder appears.

graveyardShift.experience.reducedMotion.markdownDescription: Use still frames instead of animation. Your system's reduced-motion preference is always respected as well.

graveyardShift.experience.focusMode.markdownDescription: While I'm actively using the editor, hold reminders for up to 2 minutes, then show them quietly in the sidebar and status bar instead of a notification.

graveyardShift.experience.idleMinutes.markdownDescription: Minutes without IDE interaction after which activity estimates pause. Idle time is never counted as a break.

scripts.build: npm run build:host && npm run build:webview
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p src/shared && tsc -p src/extension && tsc -p src/webview && tsc -p tests
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
